content.comment_body: Additional questions can be found in the following discussions: how to change a ladder diagram display from portrait to landscape? I am unable to find a clear explanation regarding the difference between 'M' coils and 'IM' coils, and I'm also unsure what the 'X' blocks represent. I have a small PCB that consists only of switches with pegs designed for input termination holes. This device could be very useful, but its configuration does not fit my needs. It's labeled PCB5201, and I suspect it might be a [company_name] part. Is there a similar accessory that works with the [product_name] DC12/24 relay series? I can provide an image of the PCB if needed. Thank you, [user_name]

Hello, IMs are automatically created when programming in ladder diagram (LAD) as Internal Markers. If programming in function block diagram (FBD), IMs are not required. I couldn't locate any details about your PCB. I don't believe it's a [company_name] product. Hope this is helpful.

Based on your description, it sounds like this might be a legacy part from an older [product_name] starter kit. There isn't a matching accessory for the [product_name], but you can improvise using terminals and wires.
